Loss report: gitlab -> tekton
[lost] pipeline/.shared/job/run job.runner (the runner labels need a taskRunSpecs podTemplate nodeSelector (runner.pipemaster.io/ubuntu-latest=true) on the PipelineRun, and this output has no generated TriggerTemplate to hold it)
[lost] pipeline/.shared/trigger/0 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gha (event) is not written to the Tekton file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/.shared/trigger/0 trigger.api (Tekton has no API trigger kind; only an EventListener entry of a Tekton file is kept)
[external] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner: workers the operator provides (label the nodes runner.pipemaster.io/ubuntu-latest=true for the runner labels (taskRunSpecs podTemplate nodeSelector of the TriggerTemplate))
[external] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.push: Secret pipemaster-github-webhook (create the Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token holding the GitHub webhook secret; the github interceptor rejects a webhook that it does not sign)
[emulated] pipeline/.shared ext.passthrough: pipeline id renamed (pipeline id .shared is not a DNS-1123 label; written as shared)
[emulated] pipeline/.shared/job/run/step/run-step-1 step.image: default image (the step names no image and Tekton requires one; alpine:3.22 runs it)
[emulated] pipeline/.shared/job/run/step/run-step-1 step.shell: bash-if-present preamble in the script (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the script starts with a line that re-runs it under bash -e when the image has bash, else it runs under sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/ci project.multi_pipeline: one Pipeline document per IR pipeline (each pipeline gets its own trigger)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.image: default image (the step names no image and Tekton requires one; alpine:3.22 runs it)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.shell: bash-if-present preamble in the script (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the script starts with a line that re-runs it under bash -e when the image has bash, else it runs under sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
